approved: Team review and CTO, 2026-10-30 (brand package Final_v6, brighter Navy, Ocean, Maroon and Gold)
package: OrbGSS_Logo_Tasarim_Last.zip, folder Final_v6/ (Final_v2/ to Final_v5/, the Violet package and the older Agate folder final/ are superseded and not used)

rules.ocean: the only interactive accent: links, active navigation, focus (#006CCA on light grounds, #54A4FB on dark grounds)
rules.gold: a restrained highlight and a non-text mark; never a button fill and never body text on a light ground
rules.logo_only: Navy (wordmark and outer orbit), Maroon (vertical orbit) and Deep Gold (inner orbit on light grounds) live in the logo files only; never UI colours
rules.map: no brand colour is drawn on a map: the area of interest is a white dashed line with a dark halo
rules.minimum_sizes: horizontal logo 120 px wide, symbol 32 px; below that the app icon

not_used: Final_v6/assets/illustrative-map.jpg is a generated illustration and is not placed on any page

logo-light.purpose: horizontal logo for light grounds: header and footer on every page
logo-light.transform: metadata element and its xmlns:c2pa declaration removed; drawing unchanged

favicon.purpose: favicon tile, Night with the dark-ground symbol (32 px design size)
favicon.transform: metadata element and its xmlns:c2pa declaration removed; drawing unchanged

favicon-ico.purpose: multi-size favicon (16, 32, 48 px) at the site root, where browsers ask for it
